billed.description: What their invoices and credit notes dated inside the run moved on the receivables account, GST included, credit notes negative.

collected.description: What their receipts dated inside the run took off the receivables account.

deferred_closing.description: What their deferral schedules hold at the end of the run.

direct.description: The part of recognised credited straight to revenue by their invoices and credit notes.

other_movement.description: The receivable's movement less billed plus collected: refunds, credits applied, write-offs, deposits and anything else.

receivable_movement.description: The movement of what they owe, from the receivables sub-ledger at the end of the run less the day before.

recognised.description: The revenue recognised from them inside the run: released from their deferral schedules plus what their invoices credited straight to revenue.

released.description: The part of recognised released from their deferral schedules (the Released column).

unexplained.description: What is left of the other movement when their other documents' effect is taken off: zero when billed less collected plus those documents explains the movement.
